comment: Injection-detector patterns for externally-sourced library content (386_injection_flags.py): (name, regex) pairs scanned against LOWERCASED text at ingest time. The tank decides nothing here -- matched names are FLAGS on the write (action_log + passport chain + endpoint response) so reviewers get a concrete reason to look harder. This file OVERRIDES the shipped defaults in the code; an unreadable file or an entry with an invalid regex falls back to the shipped pattern individually, so a broken edit can only restore today's behavior, never turn the detector off. Write regexes for lowercase text (the scanner lowercases first). Bias stays recall-over-precision by design: a false flag costs one human glance, a missed planted instruction costs an agent's next hundred decisions.
